query:
SELECT 
  p.botanical_family,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM plants p
LEFT JOIN molecule_plant_sources mps ON p.id = mps.plant_id
WHERE mps.id IS NULL
GROUP BY p.botanical_family
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 20;
